lines.text: Ten at night. Shanti Nagar, Mumbai. The river is rising, and every phone is calling for help.
पानी घुटनों तक आ गया है, पोते को बुखार है… गली चार, हनुमान मंदिर के पीछे
lines.caption: “The water is up to our knees, my grandson has a fever… Lane 4, behind the Hanuman temple.”

lines.text: One duty officer gets hundreds of messages at once: the same family three times, rumours, and voice notes in three languages.
Boats go in the order calls arrive, so the families in most danger wait the longest. On our test night, almost eight hours.
lines.caption: Boats go in the order calls arrive, so the families in most danger wait the longest. On our test night, almost eight hours (463 minutes).

lines.text: This is Pukaar. An agent for the ward duty officer. Built by Team Seekers.
It isn't a chatbot. For every serious event, an L L M planner makes a plan, calls one tool, looks at the result, and plans again.
lines.caption: It isn't a chatbot. For every serious event, an LLM planner makes a plan, calls one tool, looks at the result, and plans again.

lines.text: It reads memory: this family's messages, the ward's blocked lanes, and what it decided earlier tonight. And it can only propose. Every boat needs a person's approval.
Watch it live. Kamla sends a voice note, in Hindi.
The planner checks for an existing ticket, finds none, opens one for her family, and scores it.
Her daughter writes from Pune. Now the planner finds Kamla's ticket with a match score of one point zero five, and merges it. Priority one, with every reason written out.
lines.caption: Her daughter writes from Pune. Now the planner finds Kamla's ticket with a match score of 1.05, and merges it. Priority one, with every reason written out.

lines.text: Every step and its reason is in the agent reasoning panel. If the model breaks a rule, or the free model is slow, that step is rejected and the rules take over.
Now the human decides. Boat 1 has a medic and is eleven minutes away. The officer approves.
The crew accepts, and Kamla's phone gets the arrival time and a code. At the door, the code matches. Safe.
On a full replay of three hundred and eleven messages, the wait for the most urgent families fell from four hundred and sixty three minutes to twenty, and every rumour was caught.
lines.caption: On a full replay of 311 messages, the wait for the most urgent families fell from 463 minutes to 20, and every rumour was caught.

lines.text: Pukaar means, a call for help. We make sure every one is answered. Team Seekers.
